title: Market Trading Guide: Tech Mahindra, Angel One among 5 stock recommendations for Friday - Trading Guide | The Economic Times
text:
Indian equities recovered from early losses in a volatile session, as sustained foreign inflows and selective buying outweighed firm crude and the proposed US tariffs. Analysts say near-term sentiment remains constructive but volatile, as foreign liquidity should help limit the downside, while global rates, crude and trade negotiations could cap valuation expansion.Here are five stock recommendations for Friday

Kansai Nerolac has witnessed a notable improvement in its price structure after breaking above a falling trendline on the daily chart. Following the breakout, the stock underwent a period of consolidation and successfully retested the breakout zone, indicating strength at lower levels. It has now moved above the consolidation range with healthy volumes, signalling renewed buying interest. Additionally, the stock has sustained above its 200-Day EMA, reflecting a gradual improvement in the broader trend.Sachin Gupta, VP - Technical Research, Choice Broking

Tata Consumer has displayed strong bullish price action following a breakout from its recent trading range. The stock successfully retested the breakout zone before resuming its upward trajectory with a gap-up move backed by healthy volumes, highlighting fresh buying interest. It has also sustained above the upper Bollinger Band, reflecting strong price momentum and buying pressure. The RSI is currently placed at 74.96, indicating robust bullish momentum, although the elevated reading suggests the possibility of intermittent consolidation.Sachin Gupta, VP - Technical Research, Choice Broking

Agarwal Eye has registered a decisive breakout from its recent trading range and is currently trading at fresh all-time highs, reflecting strong bullish sentiment and sustained buying interest. The stock is comfortably positioned above its 20-Day, 50-Day and 200-Day EMAs, indicating a positive trend across short-, medium- and long-term timeframes. Momentum indicators further reinforce the bullish setup, with the MACD line at 18.34 trading above the signal line at 15.65. Both lines are positioned above the zero mark, while expanding green histogram bars indicate improving positive momentum.Sachin Gupta, VP - Technical Research, Choice Broking

The stock has gained 2.97%, forming a strong bullish candle and approaching its recent swing high. The price remains comfortably above the rising 200 EMA, reinforcing the long-term positive trend. A sustained breakout above Rs 1,860–1,870 could attract fresh buying interest and open further upside towards Rs 1,900–1,950.Virat Jagad, Sr. Technical Research Analyst, at Bonanza Portfolio

Angel One is exhibiting strong bullish momentum, supported by a steady recovery from its recent lows. The stock has gained 2.53%, forming a strong bullish candle and approaching a key resistance zone. The price remains comfortably above the rising 200 EMA, reinforcing the positive trend. A sustained breakout above Rs 360–365 could pave the way for further upside towards Rs 380–400.Virat Jagad, Sr. Technical Research Analyst, at Bonanza Portfolio
